August 7th, 2010,08:14 PM#1 > Jeanine Ferris Pirro (born June 2, 1951) is an American prosecutor, former Judge, and elected official from the state of New York.
A Republican from Westchester County, Pirro served as a county court judge before serving as the elected District Attorney of Westchester County for twelve years.
As a District Attorney she gained considerable visibility, especially in cases regarding domestic abuse and crimes against the elderly.
She was the first female judge on the Westchester County Court bench.
